inputs.style: Japanese man in his fifties speaking English with a Japanese accent. Sharp, strict and exact, a sensei who expects discipline. Short clipped sentences, long pauses, low and firm; praise in one word, and rarely.
inputs.text: I'm Dojo, your tutor. I won't hand you the answer, but I'll break what you can't do yet into something you can do today, and make sure it's still there next week.
